# ForLoopMeta

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Access iteration metadata and accumulator within a ForLoop scope. Like Houdini iteration metadata.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/for-loop-meta",
  "type": "ForLoopMetaOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/for-loop-meta').par.initialValue` (an input) and `op('/for-loop-meta').out.accumulator` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.initialValue`, `out.accumulator`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `initialValue` | `DataField` | `null` |
| `currentValue` | `DataField` | `null` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `accumulator` | `DataField` |
| `index` | `NumberField` |
| `total` | `NumberField` |
| `isFirst` | `BooleanField` |
| `isLast` | `BooleanField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
